items.title: Office of PSA in collaboration with MEA, IISc, ORF and GIS to organise 3rd edition of Technology Dialogue focusing on Charting Technological Convergence from 30 November to 2 December 2026
points: The third edition of the Technology Dialogue, themed “Charting Technological Convergence,” will be held from 30 November to 2 December 2026 at the Indian Institute of Science (IISc), Bengaluru .

The Dialogue is being convened by the Office of the Principal Scientific Adviser to the Government of India, in partnership with the Ministry of External Affairs, Government of India ; Indian Institute of Science, Bengaluru; Observer Research Foundation (ORF); and Global Innovation Square (GIS).
